entities.summary: Godfrey of Amiens (1066–1115) was a bishop of Amiens. He is a saint in the Catholic Church. Godfrey of Amiens was a religious figures from Ully-Saint-Georges (1066, Ully-Saint-Georges–1115-11-15). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
